dashboard.label: Collection Status
dashboard.description: If Rainfall Totals is empty, start here. Events sent to an index that does not exist are dropped. This page searches every index and the Splunk poller log.

html.p: Create the index, then point the input at it:

ol.li: Settings → Indexes → New Index → name zentra_validate → Save (or $SPLUNK_HOME/bin/splunk add index zentra_validate).
Settings → Data inputs → ZENTRA Cloud Weather → open validate.
Confirm Index is zentra_validate (not main) and API token is filled.
Disable the input, Save, Enable it again to force a poll. Wait about a minute.

html.p: Search index=_internal zentra_weather if the tables below are empty.

table.title: ZENTRA readings in ANY index (empty means the poller has not indexed yet)

search.query: index=* (sourcetype=zentra:reading OR sourcetype=zentra:weather OR source=zentra_weather://*) | stats count as events max(_time) as last_event by index, sourcetype | eval last_event=strftime(last_event, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - events

table.title: Poller log (splunkd) — look for skipping, poll failed, or index=zentra_validate

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd zentra_weather | sort - _time | table _time, _raw | head 50

table.title: Dropped because the index does not exist

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd ("unconfigured/disabled/deleted index" OR "received event for unconfigured") zentra_validate | sort - _time | table _time, _raw | head 20
